name: skill-institutional-tw-report-research
description: Maintain auditable Taiwan listed/OTC institutional research intelligence: broker/advisory reports, ratings, target prices, EPS revisions, investor-conference linkage, consensus, and TWSE/TPEx institutional-flow comparison.

deployments.note: Reference-only: GoogleAlertManager reads this skill's output via data/institutional_reports/{stock_id}.json (see src/analysis/institutional.py), not by running the skill itself, which needs TW-institutional-research's own data files and its investorconference-ingest/digest dependencies that don't exist in this repo.
